title: Step 1 - Creating a Decision Tree Regressor: Using rpart Function in R

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這個教學。

cues.en: In the previous sections, we already introduced two non-linear regression models, the polynomial regression model and the SVR regression model.
cues.zh: 前面已介紹兩個非線性迴歸模型：多項式迴歸和 SVR。

cues.en: And today we're going to introduce a new non-linear regression model, which is the decision tree regression model.
cues.zh: 今天介紹新的非線性模型，也就是決策樹迴歸。

cues.en: So far the best model we had for our data set and our specific problem was the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，對這份資料集與具體問題，表現最好的是多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Let's see how decision tree regression will do and compare it to the previous ones.
cues.zh: 現在看看決策樹迴歸表現如何，並和前面模型比較。

cues.en: So let's start with the basics.
cues.zh: 先從基本設定開始。

cues.en: Let's set the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 將正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So right now I'm going to the regression folder and we are now in decision tree regression, almost getting to the end.
cues.zh: 進入 Regression 資料夾，再到 Decision Tree Regression，已經快學完了。

cues.en: So this is the right folder containing the Position_Salaries.csv file.
cues.zh: 這就是包含 Position_Salaries.csv 的正確資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure of that.
cues.zh: 請確認。

cues.en: And click on this More button here and set as working directory.
cues.zh: 點 More，再選 Set as Working Directory。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now let's take our regression templates to build this model efficiently.
cues.zh: 現在使用迴歸模板，有效率地建立模型。

cues.en: So we take everything from here to here and pasting it here, right?
cues.zh: 複製這裡到這裡的全部內容，再貼到這裡。

cues.en: And now we just need to change a few things.
cues.zh: 只需修改幾個地方。

cues.en: So let's change the basics.
cues.zh: 先改基本內容。

cues.en: Let's replace your regression model by decision tree regression.
cues.zh: 將 Regression Model 換成 Decision Tree Regression。

cues.en: All right, we're gonna copy that and put that same title here.
cues.zh: 複製相同標題到這裡。

cues.en: All right, visualizing the decision tree regression result.
cues.zh: 也就是 Visualizing the Decision Tree Regression Results。

cues.en: And same here.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣。

cues.en: All right, and now let's change the most important thing, which is the part where we create our regressor.
cues.zh: 現在修改最重要的部分，也就是建立迴歸器的程式。

cues.en: So I'm gonna remove that comment line here.
cues.zh: 我移除這行註解。

cues.en: And now let's build our decision tree regression model.
cues.zh: 現在建立決策樹迴歸模型。

cues.en: So it's gonna be the same thing as any time.
cues.zh: 做法和之前一樣。

cues.en: We're gonna import a package and then use a function from this package to build our regressor.
cues.zh: 匯入套件，再用其中的函數建立迴歸器。

cues.en: So this package for decision true regression in R will be the rpart package.
cues.zh: 在 R 裡，決策樹迴歸要使用 rpart 套件。

cues.en: For those of you who don't have the rpart package in your packages here, I will type this comment line so that you can install it.
cues.zh: 如果你的套件清單沒有 rpart，我會寫出這行註解，供你安裝。

cues.en: So as you can see, mine is already here, rpart.
cues.zh: 我的清單裡已經有 rpart。

cues.en: Just check if you have it, and if you don't have it, just type here, install.packages, and then in the parenthesis, in quotes, you type the name of the package, which is rpart.
cues.zh: 先檢查是否有；如果沒有，輸入 install.packages，括號與引號裡填 rpart。

cues.en: All right, and then you just select this line, execute, and this will install the package.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行，就會安裝套件。

cues.en: All right, but I'm going to put this line as comment.
cues.zh: 不過我將這行改成註解。

cues.en: Just press Command + Shift + C.
cues.zh: 按 Command+Shift+C。

cues.en: And now let's also add this line library and then parenthesis the name of the package we want to select while import, rpart, right?
cues.zh: 再加入 library，括號裡填要載入的套件名稱 rpart。

cues.en: And as you can see, rpart is not selected here, and when this line of code will be executed, then this will be selected here.
cues.zh: 目前 rpart 尚未選取；執行這行後就會載入。

cues.en: All right, and now we are ready to start building the model.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始建立模型。

cues.en: So as I just said we are gonna take a function from this rpart library and this function is actually rpart, as well.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，從 rpart 套件取用函數，而函數也叫 rpart。

cues.en: So let's use this function, and as usual, we're gonna call our regressor regressor.
cues.zh: 使用這個函數，一樣將迴歸器命名為 regressor。

cues.en: So here it is.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: So that's our decision tree regression regressor.
cues.zh: 這就是決策樹迴歸器。

cues.en: And let's now use the rpart function.
cues.zh: 現在呼叫 rpart。

cues.en: All right, so now let's see what arguments we need to input.
cues.zh: 看看需要輸入哪些引數。

cues.en: The best way to do that is to press F1 here so that we get the info about the rpart library.
cues.zh: 最方便的方法是按 F1，查看 rpart 的說明。

cues.en: So usually we have it here, but then we just need to click on this link here and that will give us info about this rpart library.
cues.zh: 通常會在這裡，點這個連結，就能取得 rpart 的資訊。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see what we have.
cues.zh: 看看內容。

cues.en: The first argument is formula.
cues.zh: 第一個引數是 formula。

cues.en: So you know what to do here.
cues.zh: 你知道怎麼做。

cues.en: We just need to write formula equals the dependent variable, then a tilde, and then a dot that represents all your independent variables, all right?
cues.zh: 寫 formula 等於應變數，再加波浪號，最後加代表所有自變數的句點。

cues.en: But that we know perfectly.
cues.zh: 這已很熟悉。

cues.en: Then data.
cues.zh: 接著是 data。

cues.en: So data is the data set on which we want to build our decision tree regression model.
cues.zh: 也就是用來建立決策樹迴歸模型的資料集。

cues.en: So since we did not build any training set, data is going to be the data set, exactly like polynomial regression and SVR regression, all right?
cues.zh: 這次沒有建立訓練集，所以 data 就是 dataset，和多項式迴歸、SVR 相同。

cues.en: Then weights is an optional argument.
cues.zh: weights 是選用引數。

cues.en: You can add some weights to make your model more advanced, but, you know, this is more advanced, so we will not cover that right now.
cues.zh: 可加入權重，讓模型更進階；不過這比較深入，目前先不介紹。

cues.en: And then you have some other arguments that are optional but that can help you make your model even more robust, or, you know, include some regularization techniques or optimization to prevent overfitting,
cues.zh: 還有其他選用引數，能讓模型更穩健，或加入正規化與最佳化，避免過度擬合，

cues.en: that sort of things.
cues.zh: 諸如此類。

cues.en: But right now we just want to build a simple decision tree regression model because we have a simple data set and so we only need formula and data.
cues.zh: 目前資料集簡單，只想建立基本模型，所以只需要 formula 與 data。

cues.en: So let's go back to R and let's input these arguments.
cues.zh: 回到 R，輸入這些引數。

cues.en: So the first argument was formula, and then as I mentioned, it's formula equals salary, because it's our dependent variable,
cues.zh: 第一個是 formula，如剛才所說，寫 formula=Salary，因為 Salary 是應變數，

cues.en: then tilde, just pressing Alt + N here, and then a dot or actually level.
cues.zh: 再加波浪號，按 Alt+N，最後加句點，或直接寫 Level。

cues.en: But, you know, I wanna make this script that can be also applied to your data set, so I'll use a dot.
cues.zh: 但為了讓腳本也適用你的資料集，我使用句點。

cues.en: All right, so that's the first argument, and now let's give the second one.
cues.zh: 第一個引數完成，接著第二個。

cues.en: The second one was data.
cues.zh: 第二個是 data。

cues.en: So data equals data set.
cues.zh: 寫 data=dataset。

cues.en: And now our regressor is ready to be built.
cues.zh: 現在迴歸器已準備好建立。
